AdminAlertDto.description: One row of the admin alerts (newest first). The ring is in-memory — it clears on a backend restart, so this is a triage view, not a durable log.

kind.description: The closed vocabulary of ThrottleAlert: submission daily cap / OTP contact cap / near-duplicate.

retryAfterSeconds.description: Present only for the 429 alerts (the seconds the caller must wait).

subject.description: The flagged account or contact (user:<id> / contact:<normalized>).

AdminAuditDto.description: One row of the moderation audit trail — newest first. Every moderation-relevant action (admin AND automatic AUTO_CONFIRM).

moderatorName.description: The acting admin's profile name; 'Unknown' if the account no longer exists.

newStatus.description: The review_status value after the action; null for DELETE.

previousStatus.description: The review_status value before the action; equal to newStatus when the action does not move the review state.

reason.description: The REJECT/NEEDS_INFO note when given; null otherwise.

shelterName.description: Resolved at read time; renders 'Deleted shelter' once the row is gone (the audit row outlives the shelter).

AdminShelterDto.description: One row of the admin shelter list — every shelter, ALL statuses (auto-hidden rows included), id-ordered, with the same batched trust derivations as the public list plus the submitter's profile name. This is the one surface where all six provenance values are reachable (the list keeps hidden rows).

inaccurate.description: The same server-derived moderator flag as on ShelterDto — the admin list is where the mark is managed.

locationKind.description: The private-home declaration (the 'Private location' badge renders on this surface too).

nonexistentReports.description: The NON_EXISTENT subset of the community reports; 0 when none.

provenance.description: The same server-derived value as on ShelterDto — all six values are reachable here (the list keeps hidden rows).

reviewNote.description: The admin's REJECT reason; null while nothing is said.

reviewStatus.description: The row's trust state — the 'Unconfirmed' tab filters USER + NEW.

submitter.description: The creator's profile name; null for registry rows (no author) and for creators whose account no longer exists.

AdminShelterHistoryDto.description: One row of a shelter's edit history — ascending over the row's lifecycle events (CREATED / EDITED / DELETED).

actorName.description: The acting account's profile name; 'Unknown' after erasure (no FK on actor_user_id).

changes.description: The server-parsed {field, from, to} list of an EDITED row (the frontend renders, never parses the stored JSON); empty for CREATED/DELETED.

shelterName.description: The SNAPSHOT at event time — renames do not rewrite history (an EDITED row after a rename shows the name as it was when the event happened).

AdminShelterReportDto.description: One row of the admin shelter-report queue. The reporter's identity (profile name + e-mail) is admin-only data, never exposed outside /admin/*. dismissed is the queue's resolved marker (dismissed_at != null); dismissed rows stay in the list, recorded as resolved. damped flags the self-interested negative votes (recorded and shown, contributing 0 to the weighted auto-hide tally).

damped.description: The self-interested negative-vote flag (community self-moderation): recorded and shown, contributing 0 to the weighted auto-hide tally.

dismissed.description: The queue's resolved marker (dismissed_at != null); dismissed rows stay in the list, recorded as resolved.

reporterEmail.description: admin-only: the reporter's e-mail — reporter identity, never exposed outside /admin/*.

reporterName.description: admin-only: the reporter's profile name — reporter identity, never exposed outside /admin/*.

AdminUserDto.description: The admin user-suspension list row — the account identity the Users tab needs plus its suspension state. kind is the machine value (GUEST | REGISTERED | ADMIN); guests never appear in the list (they have no credentials to suspend), and an ADMIN row is listed so the provisioned account is visible but not suspendable (409).

email.description: admin-only: the account's e-mail, served from /admin/* only (the reporter-identity convention).

kind.description: The account kind (machine value): REGISTERED | ADMIN. Guests never appear in the list; an ADMIN row is not suspendable (409).

suspendedAt.description: The suspension stamp; null while the account is active.

CodeSentDto.description: The ack body of a 'code sent' endpoint (verification request, password-reset request, contact-change request).

resendAvailableAfterSeconds.description: Seconds the client should wait before asking for the same code again — the server-enforced resend cooldown (0 = no cooldown configured).

code.description: The 6-digit code sent to the account's other contact channel.

DataSourceDto.description: Where the map's official shelter data comes from: the publisher, the link to the official open-data page, and when the last import ran.

FieldChange.description: The server-parsed {field, from, to} list of an EDITED row (the frontend renders, never parses the stored JSON); empty for CREATED/DELETED.

InfoRequest.description: The moderator→submitter information exchange for this row; null when none exists. The admin sees the request together with the submitter's reply here (the row is kept after the reply — audit posture), with the requesting admin's profile name ('Unknown' after erasure — no FK on requested_by).

LastImport.description: One data_imports audit row: when the import ran, its outcome, the source version it saw, and the record delta.

LocationResolvedDto.description: The resolved coordinates — the frontend's LocationResolved model (the field names are the contract, do not rename).

LoginRequest.description: Login payload — the user logs in with whichever contact they registered (e-mail address or phone number).

emailOrPhone.description: The registered e-mail address or the normalized E.164 phone number.

MeResponse.description: The authenticated user's real profile + REAL verification claims — the response of GET /account/me and PUT /account/profile.

isAdmin.description: Always present: the frontend gates the admin route and nav item on it. Reflects the freshly loaded user's KIND (kind is the truth) — true only for the ADMIN-kind account, never derived from any token claim.

levels.description: Exactly the levels that are actually verified for this account (non-revoked claims), in enum order for a stable body — the frontend's single source of truth for its verification labels.

items.description: Exactly the levels that are actually verified for this account (non-revoked claims), in enum order for a stable body — the frontend's single source of truth for its verification labels.

Occupancy.description: The fresh (≤ 2 h) occupancy block: the latest fresh report's band, the number of fresh reports agreeing with it (1 = hedged copy, 2+ = firm), and the newest fresh report's time. null when nothing is fresh.

OpenStatus.description: The live open/closed block: the latest fresh tap's state, the number of fresh taps agreeing with it, and the newest fresh tap's time. null when nothing is fresh (≤ 2 h).

PasswordResetConfirmRequest.description: Password-reset confirmation payload (03-auth.puml). The e-mail scopes the confirmation to the account the code was sent to.

code.description: The 6-digit code from the reset e-mail — the secret of this call.

email.description: The address the reset code was sent to.

ProfileUpdateRequest.description: Profile-edit payload (PUT /account/profile): name only, confirmed by the account's current password. E-mail and phone stay governed by the cross-channel change flows.

currentPassword.description: The account's current password — the confirmation for the edit.

name.description: The new display name; stored as given.

refreshToken.description: The refresh token issued by the login or refresh response.

RegisterRequest.description: Registration payload (03-auth.puml). No national ID code is collected (remove-national-id M1).

email.description: The account e-mail — a login contact and the e-mail verification channel.

name.description: Display name; stored as given (registration has no canonicalization).

phone.description: The account phone in E.164 form (e.g. +37250000001) — a login contact and the SMS verification channel.

ShelterDto.description: The versioned read contract with the frontend (05-shelter-api.puml; machine-readable: docs/api/openapi.json). Lean projection — the UI gets only what the map needs; every derivation is computed server-side, never client-computed.

capacity.description: USER-submission detail (capacity); null on registry rows without capacity data.

description.description: USER-submission detail (stored since the V3 hardening pass); null on registry rows.

id.description: The shelter id — public (public GET), so 403-vs-404 on author mutations leaks nothing.

inaccurate.description: The server-derived moderator 'inaccurate' flag (idempotent mark/clear behind the admin endpoints). A marked row stays visible with status and provenance untouched.

lastVerifiedAt.description: The per-entry verification stamp: registry rows — the newest non-failed import of their source (a NOT_MODIFIED 304 re-check verifies; FAILED/SKIPPED do not); community rows — the newest non-submitter OPEN_CONFIRMED report or CONFIRM/AUTO_CONFIRM moderation action. null = never verified (the UNDER_REVIEW 'not yet verified' signal).

locationKind.description: The submitter's private-home declaration; PRIVATE rows are public results with the 'Private location' badge.

nonexistentReports.description: The NON_EXISTENT subset of the community reports (0 when none) — the UI's orange 'Reported' affordance fires at > 0. Distinct from reportCount (the TOTAL).

provenance.description: Server-derived single answer to 'where does this row come from' (OFFICIAL / PARTNER_VERIFIED / COMMUNITY_REPORTED / UNDER_REVIEW / REPORTED_INACTIVE / REJECTED — see the Provenance derivation precedence). Only the first four are reachable in the ACTIVE-only public list. The UI never re-derives it.

reportCount.description: The TOTAL community shelter-report count (all types). Distinct from nonexistentReports (the NON_EXISTENT subset that drives the 'Reported' badge).

reviewNote.description: The admin's REJECT reason; null while nothing is said. Owner-scoped on the public surfaces.

reviewStatus.description: The row's trust state: NEW (unverified community row — the amber 'newly added' treatment), CONFIRMED (community-checked, or registry rows, which backfill CONFIRMED), REJECTED (hidden — visible in /mine and the admin list only).

submitterVerified.description: true when the shelter's creator exists and has a completed verification; false for registry shelters (no author) and for creators whose account no longer exists.

yourOccupancyBand.description: CALLER-scoped: the caller's own live occupancy band for this shelter. Detail endpoint only; null for guests, anonymous callers and users without a report.

yourOpenStatus.description: CALLER-scoped: the caller's own live open/closed state (detail endpoint only; same null rules as yourOccupancyBand).

accessToken.description: Issued access JWT (credential — never log, never store in the document).

expiresIn.description: The access token's time-to-live in seconds.

refreshToken.description: Issued refresh token (credential — hashed at rest, rotated on every refresh; never log).

VerifyConfirmRequest.description: POST /verify/confirm body — the channel and the code the user received (e-mail token or SMS OTP).

code.description: The code from the e-mail token or the SMS OTP.

bearerAuth.description: The `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>` header read by the JWT filter. A valid token of a SUSPENDED account authenticates nothing (fresh per-request DB lookup — the DB is the truth, never a token claim).
bearerAuth.name: bearerAuth

info.description: The machine-readable contract of the OpenShelter backend. Companion to the human contracts: context-and-tasks/05-shelter-api.puml (the read contract), the README 'API' section and docs/whitepaper.md. Served at /v3/api-docs in dev/test only (SPRINGDOC_ENABLED); the committed snapshot is docs/api/openapi.json. Every non-2xx response carries the uniform ErrorResponse body.

delete.description: The account erasure: the declared private homes are purged, the public community rows are orphaned (map data outlives accounts), and the DB cascades credentials, claims, pending changes, tokens and reports. The verified-user gate matches the submission gates (403 without a claim); a repeat call is an idempotent no-op — the JWT is valid until its expiry, but the account is already gone.

tags.name: Account & verification
tags.description: Verification codes for the account's contacts. Both calls require a Bearer JWT (the user is resolved from the token, never from the body; the target contact comes from the user profile). The request endpoint is additionally throttled per client IP on top of the service-level cooldown + daily cap per (user, level) — a throttled 429 carries the exact remaining seconds in Retry-After. SMART_ID is rejected up front with 400 (the provider is a stub in v1).

tags.name: Public shelters
tags.description: The community shelter map. The list and detail reads are PUBLIC (guests can watch — an emergency map must be viewable without an account); every mutation requires a Bearer JWT and a verified registered account. Note the deliberate split: GET /mine is authenticated even though the rest of /api/shelters/** is public.

tags.name: Admin moderation
tags.description: Every operation requires a valid Bearer JWT AND an ADMIN-kind account, checked by a fresh per-request DB lookup — the JWT's userId is loaded and its kind checked, never a role claim in the token (a JWT minted before a demotion/deletion keeps failing). Anonymous → 401; authenticated non-admin → 403 (the x-admin-only extension marks these operations machine-readably). Reporter identity is served from this API ONLY.

tags.name: Public guidance
tags.description: The public crisis-guidance reads — permit-all (no JWT): the /blog pages read these anonymously. PUBLISHED posts only, pinned first; a draft slug and an unknown slug answer the SAME 404 (a draft's existence is never revealed).

tags.name: Admin guidance
tags.description: Every operation requires a valid Bearer JWT AND an ADMIN-kind account, checked by a fresh per-request DB lookup — the JWT's userId is loaded and its kind checked, never a role claim in the token (a JWT minted before a demotion/deletion keeps failing). Anonymous → 401; authenticated non-admin → 403 (the x-admin-only extension marks these operations machine-readably).

tags.name: Admin media

Anonymous → 401; authenticated non-admin → 403 (the x-admin-only extension marks these operations machine-readably).

tags.name: Public media
tags.description: Serving of stored hero images — permit-all (the public guidance pages show them to anonymous visitors). Only generated names (32 hex + .jpg/.png/.webp) resolve; the Content-Type comes from the stored type and the response is immutable-cacheable (generated names are never reused). Everything unknown is a 404.

tags.name: Geo
tags.description: The short-link resolver (shelter-location-input). JWT-protected (inside the authenticated set — NOT permitAll) and rate-limited per client IP (5 requests/minute) — 429 above it.

tags.name: Account & verification
tags.description: The authenticated account surface — every operation requires a Bearer JWT and the user is resolved from the token, never from the body. The change-request endpoints are additionally throttled per client IP (429 above); the confirms are code-verified and attempt-limited instead. The request endpoints ack with CodeSentDto — the cooldown a client should count down before resending.

tags.name: Data source
tags.description: The public provenance read (official-dataset-csv M5): the map is built from the Päästeamet open-data shelter dataset, and the app says so — source, link to the official open-data page, and when the last import ran. Public (no JWT).

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: The public auth surface: registration, login, refresh rotation, logout and password reset. The login/refresh responses carry bearer credentials (TokenResponse) — never log them. Login, reset-request and registration are rate-limited per real client IP (X-Forwarded-For aware) and, for login/reset, per contact — 429 above the buckets.
